gen-eater-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme reads modern and clean, with stubby ascenders tucked under a big x-height and rounded letters that stay open. But Eater earns its keep big and short, where its dark, aggressive edge and wide gaps get room.
gen-flavors-gf-preahvihear: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors gives every diagonal the same heft as its stems, under a towering x-height. Preahvihear is the sans underneath, open-mouthed with a lofty x-height, so paragraphs of text would glide along.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption reads contemporary and open, with big-bodied lowercase. The best thing here is the flat, fineliner-like line of Autour One, bold and expressive with no hairline-to-stem shift.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-hu: The plain sans body reads approachable and contemporary, its counters large and open. Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps its apertures open at tiny sizes, so text should stay inviting beneath the ornate, literary Almendra Display.
gen-audiowide-gf-radio-canada: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, futuristic and tech to the bone. Radio Canada brings a steady, pressure-free line and tall, full c, s and z, each curve ending clearly open.
gen-eater-gf-questrial: Questrial, the sans-serif here, cuts flat stencil-like strokes of single weight beneath tall, open letters. But Eater adds dark, aggressive strokes with a subtle weight change like etched glass, which the flat body sets off.
gen-flavors-gf-puritan: Flavors lets its bowls match the stems, a whimsical, commanding look with a towering x-height. And Puritan, the plain sans here, keeps rounded forms open to the side, so extended text feels clean and approachable.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-radio-canada-big: Round and loud: Autour One leads with expressive, bold letters and almost no step from capitals to lowercase. But where Autour One makes a statement, Radio Canada Big, the sans-serif, fills the line with a monoline x-height.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-duploy: Noto Sans Duployan reads contemporary and clean, its lowercase a wide-mouthed and its counters oversized. And Almendra Display takes the ornate, literary flourishes, with letters that never pinch shut, while the plain sans handles the quiet work.
gen-audiowide-gf-saira: Audiowide stamps out futuristic letters with no stress in the curves. Saira, the clean sans, leaves a see-through gap in each s and stretches rounded letters toward the top line beneath it.
